🛠️ *new finding + proposed fix — added to kb/known-issues.json as* `ki-2026-06-17-classic-timezone-iana-id-not-found`
*Surfaced by ES (not a Slack alert)* • confidence: 0.90 • bug-type: code + data

*What:* `System.TimeZoneNotFoundException: The time zone ID 'America/New_York' was not found on the local computer` — **396 errors/hr** on the Classic stack (PROD-CLASSIC-01: 200, PROD-CLASSIC-02: 196), **95% from account `thestoragegroup`** (378), supplyshield (18). Actions: fncNativeFieldDateAndTime / fncConverFromUTCTime / fncConverToUTCTime.

*Why it was invisible:* this is the **first cycle after ES/Serilog auth was restored** (chronic dev_team 401, ~17d). The burst is bursty-historical (ES: 06-03 ~23/h, 06-10 ~254/h, today 396/h) but was unseen the whole 401 window. Fresh onset today (0 at 13:00Z → 396 by 19:08Z).

*Root cause (stack + source confirmed):* `legacy-common-core` → `Method.Common/Com.Method/Utils/TimeZoneLookup.cs` → `GetSystemTimeZoneById` (~L939). Its `default` case calls `TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(tzID)` directly, which **throws** on a Windows host when given an IANA id. But every caller expects **null** (`if (tz == null) return -1`), so the throw is unhandled → logged. Triggered by accounts whose stored tz is an IANA string (`America/New_York`) instead of the Windows id (`Eastern Standard Time`) or the friendly `EASTERN` the switch already handles.

*Immediate mitigation (no deploy):* correct `thestoragegroup`'s (and `supplyshield`'s) stored timezone from `America/New_York` → `Eastern Standard Time`. Stops ~95% of the volume now.

*Durable code fix (single file, ~18 lines):* [diff in investigation doc]
(Classic deploys via TFS — rollout needs the Classic deploy owner; git/gh won't show it.)

*Evidence:*
• Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-06-17T19:08:00Z',to:'2026-06-17T20:10:00Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'%22was%20not%20found%20on%20the%20local%20computer%22'))
• Investigation: docs/investigations/2026-06-17-0ca1432921955f52.md

*Suggested next action:* file a defect for the TimeZoneLookup hardening + apply the `thestoragegroup` data fix now. Worth a one-off ES backfill over the 401 window to catch other signals that accumulated unseen.
